final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT e.status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) as member_count FROM attendance a INNER JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.status) SELECT status, member_count, CAST(member_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM status_counts) as proportion FROM status_counts ORDER BY status
